title: Running a project with AMD GPU might temporarily freeze system after some time
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in: * v4.6.stable.mono.official [89cea1439] version 4.5 and its pre-release dev builds with Mono may also be where this error has started to happen (i've got the GPU and CPU upgrade in January 2026, back then i had an Nvidia GTX card, so that's why i'm not exactly sure). Will try them later and edit this issue description with more info! ### System information Godot v4.6.stable.mono - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 08 Apr 2026 11:27:19 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7600 (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700 (16 threads) - 15.47 GiB memory ### Issue description After some time running project (regardless if it was launched from project editor or project chooser), the GPU error will occur. Here's what will happen in my environment: 1. Monitor does a soft reboot (this usually happens for me when a computer changes display resolutions or switches from [GOP](https://wiki.osdev.org/GOP) to Linux's framebuffer system (DRM if i'm not mistaken)) * It goes dark for ~3 seconds, * then displays a frozen last frame rendered. 2. GPU starts to reset. All you'll see is a frozen last frame for almost a minute. 3. After that, you'll be logged out and thrown back into login manager.

### Steps to reproduce 0. **You are warned that after GPU reset, at least in GNOME DE, you will lose all opened windows and data in them, so make sure to save and close all of your projects/stuff before doing this!** 1. Run a project with an AMD GPU 2. Interact with it for a couple of minutes ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I'm not really sure what might cause it, but my projects do use custom shaders, though not extensively and most of them are simple to compute. So, to be sure, do find a complex Godot Engine project that has custom shaders and reproduce on that.
